task: A complaints team tracks each case from new, to assigned, to closed. Working on three simulated cases, build the code that finds a case, assigns it, closes it only when that move is allowed, keeps an audit line for every close, and counts cases by state.

produce.name: board.py
produce.about: Finds, assigns, closes and counts cases, and writes the audit log.

produce.name: main.py
produce.about: Moves the cases through their states and prints the results.

steps.P06.m1: Find a case by its id, or nothing when it's missing.
steps.P06.m2: Assign a new case to an owner, and refuse any other.
steps.P06.m3: Close an assigned case, and refuse one that is still new.
steps.P06.m4: Write one audit line for each close that worked.
steps.P06.m5: Count how many cases are in each state.

problems: One case is already closed in the file, so it can't be assigned.
Two cases are still new, so neither can be closed until someone is assigned.
The file has no owner column, so every case starts with an empty owner.
